what_happened.line: The Parks Commission voted unanimously, by roll call, to have the recreation director produce a monthly MyRec report instead of giving the treasurer's office access to the database.

The beach budget covers most salaries but not preparation costs, and the capacity cap limits pass revenue, so the reopening may draw on other park funds late in a year when most of the park budget was already spent or committed.

why_it_matters: Whether the town beach opens this summer, and whether passes or swim lessons are sold, depends on state guidance and was left undecided, so families should not count on a beach season yet.
A turf field at Fitzgerald would be a capital cost with no money identified, so any proposal would later raise a question of taxes or other funding.
